title: Fix WhatsApp button not reflecting updated phone number from admin panel

requirements.text: The FloatingWhatsApp component must dynamically fetch the WhatsApp phone number from the backend canister (via the site settings query) instead of using a hardcoded or stale cached value. After the admin saves a new WhatsApp number in AdminSettings, the FloatingWhatsApp button must use the updated number immediately — ensure the React Query cache for site settings is invalidated or refetched after a successful save in AdminSettings so the customer-facing button always reflects the current backend value.

quotes: the WhatsApp button still dials the old number
the frontend button isn't reading the updated value from the backend after saving

acceptanceCriteria: FloatingWhatsApp component reads the phone number from the site settings query result, not a hardcoded string.
When an admin updates and saves a new WhatsApp number in AdminSettings, the React Query cache for site settings is invalidated.
After saving a new number in the admin panel, the FloatingWhatsApp button opens a WhatsApp chat with the newly saved number without requiring a page reload.
If no number is returned from the backend, the button falls back to a sensible default rather than throwing an error.

constraints: Do not modify files listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
Do not change the backend schema or data model — the WhatsApp number is already stored in site settings.
nonGoals: Redesigning the WhatsApp button UI or animations.
Changing how the admin save action works beyond cache invalidation.
